name: JCS Technologies Inc.
old_description: JCS Technologies specializes in high-quality wire harness design, prototyping and manufacturing.
about:
Founded in 2011 in Las Vegas, Nevada, JCS Technologies operates as a contract manufacturer specializing in wire harness design, prototyping, and production. The company has grown from its inception to serve clients requiring fast turnaround and low-volume runs with stringent quality requirements.

JCS Technologies provides end-to-end wire harness services, including design assistance, rapid prototyping with no minimum order quantities, and full-scale manufacturing. Every harness undergoes 100% individual testing before shipment, backed by a 0% failure rate guarantee that includes free replacement within 48 hours. The company recently expanded into a larger facility to support its focus on quick-turn, high-reliability projects.

The company serves the gaming, renewable energy, industrial, and amusement sectors. In gaming, it produces harnesses for casino equipment; in renewable energy, for controllers and generators; in industrial, for consumer electronics, kiosks, ATMs, and computers; and in amusement, for audio, video, control, and payment systems. Notable customers include Light & Wonder and Asahi Seiko.

JCS Technologies was built on a philosophy of eliminating unacceptable failure rates. Its quality program reflects accountability to both the customer and itself, with cross-trained professionals overseeing each production stage. The firm emphasizes that cost savings are meaningless if components prove unreliable, and it maintains UL and RoHS compliance to meet industry regulations.
